horses.incident_text: Jumped only fairly, shifted in and made contact with GOLDEN FAIRY.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped only fairly.  Near the 200 Metres was inconvenienced when taken out slightly by STAR BROSE which shifted out after being taken out slightly by STORM RUNNER.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Near the 600 Metres was bumped and taken wider by SUPER SICARIO.  STORM RUNNER then raced wide and without cover thereafter.  Again near the 450 Metres made contact with SUPER SICARIO when that runner continued to maintain its position to the outside of WAH MAY WAI WAI.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.

Jumped awkwardly.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Near the 250 Metres shifted to the inside of STAR BROSE when disappointed for clear running between PERFECT PAIRING and STAR BROSE.
Jumped awkwardly and then made contact with WAH MAY WAI WAI which shifted out slightly.
Shifted out slightly at the start and was bumped.
Near the 350 Metres was steadied when racing tight to the inside of LEATHER MASTER.  Approaching the 300 Metres was again steadied to avoid LEATHER MASTER when that runner shifted in.
Bumped at the start.

Near the 600 Metres was shifted to the outside of WAH MAY WAI WAI to commence a forward move and as a result made contact with STORM RUNNER.  Bumped near the 450 Metres.  D Probert reported that throughout the early and middle stages of the event his mount raced too keenly and refused to settle.  He said as a consequence SUPER SICARIO failed to run out the 2200 Metres of tonight’s event.  Trainer C Fownes concurred with the views of Jockey Probert and indicated that he would look to drop the horse back in distance for its next race start.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Approaching the 1600 Metres was hampered when taken out by COSMO LIGHT.  Trainer C W Chang confirmed that he had instructed Jockey R Kingscote to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Approaching the 1600 Metres, when racing keenly, shifted out when being steadied away from SUPER HONG KONG.  Raced wide and without cover from the 900 Metres after commencing a forward move from that point.  Trainer Y S Tsui confirmed that he had instructed Jockey J Orman to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages from the outside barrier as the horse had been racing in a disappointing manner when being ridden in a forward  position.  He added that he had given Jockey Orman the option of making a mid-race move if circumstances permitted.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

When questioned regarding the improved performance Trainer Y S Tsui stated that the horse was advantaged tonight by drawing an inside barrier as compared to its previous four race starts where it was drawn barrier 12.  He said after the horse’s last run on 2 November 2025 where it was obliged to race wide and without cover he gave the horse a short let-up and this, in his opinion, also contributed to its improved performance tonight.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped only fairly.  L Ferraris was reprimanded for using the whip forward of the saddle in a forehand manner on one occasion near the 100 Metres.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Near the 400 Metres was steadied when awkwardly placed between HAPPY HORSE and MACANESE MASTER.
Near the 350 Metres made contact with COLONEL when racing tight between ORIENTAL SURPRISE and COLONEL.
From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Bumped passing the 50 Metres.
Jumped awkwardly.  Passing the 50 Metres was eased when awkwardly placed to the inside of MACANESE MASTER.  A short distance later shifted out and made contact with MODEST GENTLEMAN.
Briefly held up on the Home Turn.
L Hewitson could offer no explanation for his mount’s failure to run on in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Slow to begin.

In the early stages of the Home Straight lay in and proved difficult to ride.  D Probert reported that the instructions from the outside barrier were to ride the horse with cover.  He said in the early stages CAMP FIRE raced keenly and refused to settle and near the 800 Metres got its head up when being checked away from GLORIOUS EXPERT.  Trainer D J Whyte confirmed the instructions issued and stated that at its last start it had not been the intention to lead, however, on that occasion CAMP FIRE jumped well and was able to lead the event contrary to the instructions he had issued.

Near the 350 Metres was bumped.  M F Poon stated that his mount was disadvantaged by racing wide and without cover and in addition would be better suited by being stepped up in distance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

horses.short: Must pass veterinary exam before racing again
horses.incident_text: HANDSOME BLOND, Standby Declared Starter, was withdrawn on 16.12.25 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right hind).  Before being allowed to race again, HANDSOME BLOND will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

blackbook_suggestions.reason: Must pass vet exam before racing again

horses.incident_text: Shifted in over the final 100 Metres, resulting in its rider J McDonald having to stop riding and straighten his mount after the 50 Metres.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Bumped at the start and then a short distance later was eased when racing tight to the inside of THOUSAND CUPS which shifted in.  Approaching the 1000 Metres made contact with GOLDEN DARCI when GOLDEN DARCI shifted in slightly.  Over the concluding stages shifted in and away from PERFECTDAY, resulting in its rider H Bowman having to stop riding and straighten.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
Jumped awkwardly.  Making the first turn near the 1000 Metres got its head up when positioned close to FRANCIS MEYNELL.

Shifted in at the start and was bumped.  In the middle stages raced keenly and leaving the 800 Metres was steadied to avoid HAPPY ALLIANCE.  For a short distance approaching the 200 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running when improving between HAPPY ALLIANCE and ONE AND ONLY.

From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Held up on the Home Turn.  Near the 200 Metres was steadied when racing tight to the inside of PERIDOT which shifted in and away from SMART FIGHTER.

Bumped at the start.  Over the final 150 Metres lay in and near the 100 Metres was corrected by its rider.  Over the concluding stages was checked to avoid FLOW WATER FLOW which, after being taken in by PERFECTDAY (J McDonald), then shifted in and away from that runner despite the efforts of its rider H Bowman.  J McDonald was reprimanded and advised that in similar circumstances he would be expected to stop riding and straighten his mounts sooner than what he did on this occasion.
Near the 600 Metres was eased when momentarily racing tight to the inside of SMART FIGHTER.
No report.
Hung in in the Home Straight when under pressure.
Shortly after the start made contact with SMART FIGHTER which shifted in.  Bumped approaching the 1000 Metres.  Raced wide and without cover from the 600 Metres.
On jumping was crowded by LUCKY MAN which shifted in.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Leaving the 700 Metres shifted out when being steadied away from FIGHTING MACHINE and made contact with METAL KING.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Jumped only fairly and shortly after the start was steadied when crowded between MADE FOR LIFE and SMART CITY, both of which shifted ground.  Held up for clear running on the Home Turn.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped only fairly.
In the early stages raced keenly and near the 1200 Metres got its head up.  Leaving the 150 Metres shifted in, resulting in its rider M Guyon having to stop riding and straighten his mount.
Held up on the Home Turn.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
On jumping bumped with UP WITH CHARM and shortly after shifted in and made contact with GLORIOUS JOURNEY.

Raced ungenerously when being shifted across behind runners from a wide barrier in the early stages.  Made a forward move from the 800 Metres and as a consequence raced wide and without cover for the remainder of the event.  Leaving the 700 Metres was bumped by CALIFORNIA MOXIE which shifted out.  Leaving the 100 Metres raced tight between FIGHTING MACHINE and MADE FOR LIFE which shifted out.

Bumped at the start.  K C Leung reported that the instructions were to obtain a forward position but not necessarily lead.  He said when the early and middle stages of the race were run outside of standard time, this resulted in UP WITH CHARM leading the event.

Near the 1300 Metres was steadied to avoid MADE FOR LIFE (B Avdulla) which shifted in when not clear.  B Avdulla was reprimanded.  Near the 150 Metres was steadied when disappointed for clear running between METAL KING and MADE FOR LIFE which, after shifting to the outside of ICONICAL, was then taken out slightly by that runner.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Leaving the 200 Metres shifted in abruptly away from SUPERB GUY, resulting in its rider M L Yeung having to stop riding and straighten his mount.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

In the early stages raced ungenerously when being shifted across behind runners from a wide barrier.  In the Home Straight lay in and  near the 100 Metres rider R Kingscote dropped his right rein.  When questioned regarding the improved performance Trainer C S Shum stated that he had instructed Jockey R Kingscote to settle the horse where comfortable and endeavour to make a wide run in the Home Straight.  He said after settling in a midfield position the horse was advantaged by being able to improve to the inside away from other horses and this was the only explanation he could offer for its improved performance tonight.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Near the 200 Metres made slight contact with MEGA BONUS due to both runners shifting ground.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Became unbalanced at the start when bumped.
Bumped at the start.  Near the 200 Metres made slight contact with LOVING VIBES due to both runners shifting ground.
No report.

In the Home Straight lay in and made contact with KING OBERON on a number of occasions after the 200 Metres as KING OBERON endeavoured to obtain clear running.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.

On jumping shifted in and became unbalanced when it made contact with BITS SUPERSTAR.  Over the final 200 Metres was held up for clear running between BITS SUPERSTAR and SUPERB BOY and made contact with SUPERB BOY on a number of occasions when endeavouring to obtain clear running.
Over the final 200 Metres was held up for clear running and could not be ridden out to the finish of the event.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Bumped at the start.
From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Jumped only fairly.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.

horses.short: Must pass veterinary exam before racing again
horses.incident_text: No report.  <18/12/2025 Additional Veterinary Report> The Veterinary Officer reported that THE PROMISE was lame in its right hind leg on the day after racing. Before being allowed to race again, THE PROMISE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

blackbook_suggestions.reason: Must pass vet exam before racing again

horses.incident_text: Sent for sampling post-race.
Bumped at the start.  In the early stages raced keenly and for some distance approaching the 1200 Metres was steadied to avoid FLOOF.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Crowded on jumping between CHINA WIN and SHARPEN BRIGHT, both of which shifted ground.
Bumped at the start.
No report.
No report.

Near the 350 Metres was steadied when unable to improve between DOUBLE WIN and SURE JOYFUL which shifted out.  Shifted out near the 150 Metres and was bumped.  Trainer P C Ng confirmed that from a wide barrier he had instructed Jockey C L Chau to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages.
No report.

Near the 150 Metres was bumped by PACKING HURRICANE which shifted out.  H Doyle stated that after being slow to begin her mount settled too far back in the field and found it difficult to make up ground in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Jumped only fairly.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  M F Poon reported that from a wide barrier he was instructed to ride his mount in a conservative manner in the early stages.  Trainer P F Yiu confirmed the instructions and said he issued such instructions as SURE JOYFUL was carrying the top weight of 135 lbs and therefore did not wish to make too much use of the horse in the early stages.
A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  L Ferraris stated that after making a run from back in the field his mount was taken wider making the Home Turn when DOUBLE WIN shifted out.  He added that after making contact with DOUBLE WIN near the 200 Metres when that horse shifted out, FORTUNE STAR did not finish the race off thereafter.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Kicked a rail whilst parading, was examined by the Veterinary Officer and passed suitable to race.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
No report.
No report.
In the middle stages raced keenly and near the 700 Metres was steadied to avoid SOMELOVEFROMABOVE.

In the middle stages raced keenly and near the 750 Metres was steadied away from THE PERFECT MATCH.  L Ferraris stated that from a wide barrier he was instructed to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages, similar to the manner in which it has been ridden from wide barriers in the past on the turf.

Jumped only fairly.  Approaching the 1000 Metres was checked when crowded by EXCEED THE WISH which was taken in by MEOWTH (C L Chau).  C L Chau was severely reprimanded and advised he must ensure that he leaves sufficient racing room for runners to his inside.  In considering the incident the Stewards took into account the evidence of Jockey H Bowman who said that when his mount commenced to be crowded for room it hung out across the heels of EXCEED THE WISH and contributed to the interference.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Jumped only fairly.  Approaching the 150 Metres was eased when disappointed for clear running between SOMELOVEFROMABOVE and GOKO WIN which shifted in slightly.  Z Purton reported that his mount raced keenly throughout the early and middle stages of the event and refused to settle.  He added that when GOKO WIN lost ground near the 1000 Metres BIG RETURN became badly unbalanced when being severely checked to avoid GOKO WIN.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
No report.

M Chadwick stated that he could offer no explanation for the horse’s disappointing performance.  Trainer C Fownes advised that the horse had pleased him since its last start win on 26 November 2025 and could offer no explanation for the horse’s disappointing performance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Jumped awkwardly, got its head up and lost ground.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
Approaching the 600 Metres commenced to race keenly when being steadied to allow CANDLELIGHT DINNER to cross.
Raced wide and without cover from the 600 Metres.

Shortly after the start was severely checked when crowded between CASA OF HONOR which was taken in slightly by BLUE ILLUSION and SIX THREE WIN which was taken out by DEVAS TWELVE when that runner shifted out despite the efforts of its rider M Chadwick.
Shortly after the start was contacted on the hindquarters by LOVE TOGETHER and became badly unbalanced.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Shifted out shortly after the start and made contact with SIX THREE WIN when being corrected by its rider.
No report.
Approaching the 300 Metres was bumped by BLUE ILLUSION which shifted out.  Raced very wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
Shortly after the start was crowded.  In the middle stages raced keenly and for some distance approaching the 600 Metres was steadied to avoid HAYDAY.

Shortly after the start was contacted on the hindquarters by CASA OF HONOR and as a consequence became badly unbalanced.  Shifted out approaching the 300 Metres and was bumped.  R Kingscote stated that after being bumped on the Home Turn he had concern with the horse’s action in the Home Straight and therefore did not ride it out to the finish when not in a competitive position.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

horses.incident_text: Shifted in shortly after the start, was bumped and became unbalanced.  Approaching the 200 Metres lay in and became unbalanced when racing in restricted room between A AMERIC TE SPECSO and SUPER UNICORN.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  <18/12/2025 Additional Veterinary Report> After the race, CALL ME TOPSEED was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time there were no significant findings. CALL ME TOPSEED was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer K L Man this morning. He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its right hind leg. Before being allowed to race again, CALL ME TOPSEED will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
No report.

Shortly after the start was bumped by CALL ME TOPSEED which shifted in.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
On jumping was steadied when crowded between VERMILION TEMPEST and FANTASTIC FUN, both of which shifted ground.
Jumped only fairly and then was crowded by MIGHTY STEED which shifted out.

Z Purton stated that the horse raced too keenly throughout the early and middle stages of the race and as a consequence was left without a finishing effort in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to have bled from both nostrils.  Before being allowed to race again, SOUTH STAR will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  Sent for sampling post-race.

H Bowman stated that his mount was disadvantaged by racing wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
